detail: PREDICTION: TSH's 10*1 padding is NON-INJECTIVE. padded = data+0x80, zero-fill to 32-multiple, then padded[-1] is overwritten with 0x01 - so the 0x80 marker is destroyed whenever it lands on a block's last byte (len(data) mod 32 == 31). Consequence: for EVERY X with len(X) mod 32 == 30, pad(X) == pad(X||0x80), hence TSH(X) == TSH(X||0x80) - free contrived collisions, to be measured on 30-byte and 62-byte pairs. If confirmed, TSH-512 collision resistance is broken by construction regardless of permutation strength; the frozen vector set must include such a pair as a known-collision fixture.
